examples.label: Marketing site header with sign-in and trial CTA
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-navbar" site="Global" id="marketing-site-header" max_width="extra_large" > <:start_content class="flex items-center gap-2"> <.link navigate="/" class="flex items-center gap-2"> Northwind <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/product">Product <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/pricing">Pricing <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/customers">Customers <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/blog">Blog <:end_content class="flex items-center gap-4"> <.link navigate="/sign-in" class="text-sm hover:underline">Sign in <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/sign-up" variant="default" color="primary" size="small" > Start free trial

examples.label: Documentation header with search shortcut and account avatar
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-navbar" site="Global" id="documentation-header" max_width="extra_large" > <:start_content class="flex items-center gap-2"> <.link navigate="/" class="flex items-center gap-2"> Northwind Docs <:list icon="hero-rocket-launch" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"> <.link navigate="/docs/getting-started">Getting started <:list icon="hero-book-open" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"> <.link navigate="/docs/guides">Guides <:list icon="hero-code-bracket" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"> <.link navigate="/docs/api">API reference <:list icon="hero-lifebuoy" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"> <.link navigate="/docs/support">Support <:end_content class="flex items-center gap-3"> <.link navigate="/docs/search" class="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-gray-200 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 dark:border-gray-700" > <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-magnifying-glass" class="size-4" /> Search the docs Ctrl K <.component component_name="chelekom-avatar" site="Global" src="/images/avatar1.png" rounded="full" />

examples.label: Storefront header with categories and cart count
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-navbar" site="Global" id="storefront-header" variant="bordered" max_width="extra_large" > <:start_content class="flex items-center gap-2"> <.link navigate="/" class="flex items-center gap-2"> Fern & Field <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/shop/new">New in <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/shop/plants">Plants <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/shop/planters">Pots & planters <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-70"><.link navigate="/shop/care">Plant care <:list icon="hero-truck" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="hidden lg:inline-flex text-sm opacity-70"> <.link navigate="/shipping">Free delivery over $60 <:end_content class="flex items-center gap-4"> <.link navigate="/search" class="p-1.5 hover:opacity-70"> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-magnifying-glass" class="size-5" /> <.link navigate="/account" class="p-1.5 hover:opacity-70"> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-user" class="size-5" /> <.link navigate="/cart" class="relative p-1.5 hover:opacity-70"> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-shopping-bag" class="size-5" /> 3

examples.label: Dark application top bar with workspace switcher
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-navbar" site="Global" id="app-top-bar" variant="default" color="dark" max_width="extra_large" > <:start_content class="flex items-center gap-3"> <.link navigate="/app" class="flex items-center gap-2"> Northwind <.link navigate="/app/workspaces" class="hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-white/10 px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-white/20" > Acme Corp <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-chevron-down" class="size-3.5" /> <:list icon="hero-squares-2x2" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"> <.link navigate="/app">Dashboard <:list icon="hero-inbox-stack" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"> <.link navigate="/app/projects">Projects <:list icon="hero-chart-bar" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"> <.link navigate="/app/reports">Reports <:list icon="hero-cog-6-tooth" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"> <.link navigate="/app/settings">Settings <:end_content class="flex items-center gap-3"> <.link navigate="/app/notifications" class="relative p-1.5 hover:opacity-80"> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-bell" class="size-5" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-avatar" site="Global" src="/images/avatar2.jpg" rounded="full" />

examples.label: Centered section nav for an event landing page
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-navbar" site="Global" id="event-section-nav" variant="gradient" color="primary" content_position="center" max_width="medium" > <:start_content class="flex items-center gap-2"> Northwind Summit 2026 <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"><.link href="#agenda">Agenda <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"><.link href="#speakers">Speakers <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"><.link href="#venue">Venue <:list class="text-sm hover:opacity-80"><.link href="#tickets">Tickets <:list icon="hero-sparkles" icon_class="size-4 me-1.5" class="text-sm font-medium"> <.link href="#tickets">Early bird ends Friday
